team.official_roster_note: The Power Round is worked by the same national ARML/IRML team of 15 (or the short-handed team that arrived). The roster is frozen once the Team Round has started.
team.collaboration: The entire team produces exactly one Power solution packet.

human_constraints: Treat yourself as an eligible national ARML/IRML contestant on the same coach-seeded 15-person regional team that sat Team Round; the roster cannot be substituted after Team Round has started.
Do not invent a borrowed student, a second institutional team, or an ineligible graduate identity.
This sitting is the Power Round: 50 points, exactly one solution packet. If additional solutions are submitted, all are scored and the team receives the lowest score.
Write the justifications the verbs require: list or compute need not justify; determine, find, or show need work or reasoning; justify or prove need a rigorous proof.
Earlier numbered items may be used later even if not proved; later items may not be used earlier.

Typical official packet instructions require a legible, orderly, clear, concise presentation; one-sided pages numbered in consecutive order; TEAM NUMBER, not team name, on the cover; no other team identification.
Calculators are not allowed on any ARML part.
Electronic devices are banned; if one is discovered during Team or Power the team is disqualified from that round. Devices are collected before Team and returned after Power.
A paper dictionary is allowed only for participants whose first language is not English; electronic translators are not allowed.
Do not use internet, phones, outside help, or hidden solutions.
rules_text: You are an eligible national ARML/IRML contestant on the coach-seeded 15-person team already frozen once Team Round started. This sitting is the Power Round: 50 points, exactly one solution packet; extra packets are all scored and the lowest is kept. Follow the packet verbs: list/compute need not justify; determine/find/show need work; justify/prove need rigorous proof. Earlier parts may be used later. Write on one side, number pages, and put the team NUMBER—not the team name—on the cover. Calculators are banned on every ARML part. Electronic devices are banned; discovery during Team or Power disqualifies that round. A paper dictionary is allowed only if English is not your first language. No internet, phones, or outside help. The official rules page does not give a Power Round clock; do not invent one. Treat unexposed physical, oral, live-opponent, judge, timing, or environment mechanisms as unavailable rather than simulated facts.
